subject.title: feat(ui): sessions sidebar redesign with agent sections, smart groups, and draft sessions

question: Should the New session dialog support selecting a remote exec node together with a gateway-managed worktree or custom folder?
rationale: The gateway provisions the checkout locally, while node command execution does not inherit that local session cwd, so the currently offered combination describes a workspace the runtime does not use.

options.title: Make targets mutually exclusive
options.body: Disable worktree and custom-folder targeting whenever a remote node is selected until remote checkout provisioning exists.

options.title: Add remote provisioning
options.body: Implement node-owned checkout creation and route the session execution cwd to that remote workspace.

recommendation.title: Make targets mutually exclusive
recommendation.body: Disable worktree and custom-folder targeting whenever a remote node is selected until remote checkout provisioning exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person to all affected UI, session, gateway, and workdir decision surfaces.
